before.name: Variance Log
before.description: What has happened to an invoice's variances (#648), append-only. An Admin accepts a Price variance, a Quantity variance or Totals differ with a reason (Accepted); an edit that changes the two figures it was accepted on while the variance still stands opens it again (Reopened), and one that leaves no variance clears it (Cleared). Each acceptance's state is cached on its row — Invoice Items."Price Variance Accepted" and "Quantity Variance Accepted", Invoices."Totals Differ Accepted" — written by lib/variance.server.js with the row that moved it, never by a formula.
